title: 高架逃逸 · 软着陆并刹停
summary: As escape-soft-landing, then brake (and steer) to a stop on the street: after the upright hold the episode ends once the COM's horizontal speed is at most stop_speed, within stop_within seconds of the touchdown, without a wheel ever standing on a kerb (sidewalk or median top). Brake and steer are the action entries after the nozzles (spec/drive.json, spec/README.md 5.13).
